items.source: Return the actual type of the instance found.
items.translation: 返回找到的实例的实际类型。

items.source: Return the name of the instance that was of the wrong type.
items.translation: 返回类型错误的实例名称。

items.source: Return the expected type for the bean.
items.translation: 返回 Bean 的预期类型。

items.source: Thrown when a bean doesn't match the expected type.
items.translation: 抛出当 Bean 不匹配预期类型时。

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean requested
items.translation: beanName - 请求的 Bean 的名称

items.source: actualType - the actual type returned, which did not match the expected type
items.translation: actualType - 返回的实际类型，与预期类型不匹配
